test_extend: test the Series extend method to append another Series to an existing Series
test_extend_self: test extending a Series with itself and verify the result contains duplicated elements
test_extend_bad_input: test that Series extend raises TypeError when given a DataFrame or LazyFrame instead of a Series
test_extend_with_null_series: test extending an Int64 Series with a Null Series and verify nulls are cast to Int64
test_extend_sliced: test extending a sliced Series with another Series and verify correct element ordering
